integrity: Proof is analytic; numerical checks do not certify all dimensions. No independent audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Real first Walsh level; exact original-map norm is not claimed for 1<p<2; no claim about worst-case extension over all coefficient operators. Classical Khintchine constant and Fourier minimality antecedents are credited. Potential older equivalent reformulations remain a priority risk.
title: Sharp extension costs and rigidity of finite Walsh coefficient maps
